package.description: On-ramp CLI that points Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding tools at an Anyray gateway.

en-US.description: On-ramp CLI that points Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding tools at an Anyray gateway.
en-US.longDescription:
anyray-connect configures local AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, and
compatible clients) to route their LLM traffic through an Anyray gateway. The
gateway routes requests to organization-configured LLM providers while
keeping prompt and response content within the organization's self-hosted
deployment and outside Anyray's systems. The Windows build is a single signed, self-contained executable —
no Node, nothing else to install.
en-US.name: Anyray Connect
